notes: Single source of truth for asset serial numbers (docs/asset-serial-numbers-2026-11-11.md). A serial is assigned at classification, never at photo intake — scripts/photo_pipeline.py build always writes serial null. Assignment is editorial: scripts/assign_serials.py stamps the next numbers in chainage order (west to east) per type, and only Muse proposes / Paul approves per batch. Never reuse, never renumber: a retired serial stays in retired with its reason. UN is a type value, never a serial prefix — no serial is ever issued for unclassified pins.

BN.name: bench
BN.note: Paul's example; not yet observed in any classified photo.

CP.name: carsonite post
CP.note: The trail's standard marker post. A physical mile post is a CP, not a sign — the NCTA mile-marker layer is separate data.

PK.name: parking area
PK.note: One serial per area, even if it has several signs; the signs themselves are SG items.

SG.name: sign
SG.note: One code for signs of any kind; subtype (regulatory, wayfinding, interpretive) goes in the pin's sign_kind field.

UN.name: unclassified
UN.note: A type value, never a serial prefix. Unclassified pins carry no serial.
